title: api: propagate request-id & traces through streaming, structured logs, and openai-compat layer
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Adds end-to-end propagation of request IDs and trace headers for API surface (including streaming and OpenAI-compat layer). Structured log fields included: request_id, trace_id, parent_span, endpoint_tag. Metrics now include per-endpoint tags for better cardinality control. Backwards compatible with existing clients; opt-in header support for legacy proxies.
description: Motivation: production incidents showed opaque correlation between client requests and streaming connections and gaps in structured logs from the OpenAI-compat gateway. This PR implements deterministic request_id propagation, W3C traceparent passthrough, structured log enrichment, and per-endpoint metric tags across the API stack including the streaming path and the openai-compat layer. Design summary: 1) Generate a strong request_id at gateway entry when none is provided (X-Redwood-Request-Id / OpenAI-Request-Id fallback). 2) Attach request_id and traceparent to all downstream internal RPCs and to the streaming connection lifecycle (connect, chunk, error, close). 3) Enrich structured logs emitted by the gateway, runtime, and function-caller with request_id, trace_id, span_id, endpoint Tag, model.variant, and routing policy. 4) Add metric label 'endpoint' to per-route counters/histograms, with cardinality bucketing rules described in docs to avoid high-cardinality explosion. 5) Update the OpenAI-compat layer to accept and propagate openai-style request IDs and to map them to internal request_id for trace continuity. Checklist: - [x] Request ID generation and header mapping implemented at gateway - [x] Traceparent passthrough and creation if missing - [x] Streaming lifecycle hooks instrumented with request and trace metadata - [x] Structured log schema extended and validated against logging contract - [x] Metrics labels added and unit tests for cardinality guardrails - [x] Integration tests with OpenAI-compat to verify header passthrough - [x] Docs updated (console + API reference) - [x] E2E verified in staging with simulated multi-chunk streams and function/tool calls Compatibility: existing clients are unaffected; if clients send X-Request-Id or OpenAI-Request-Id we preserve and surface it. For legacy proxies that strip traceparent, we generate and return trace parent details in response headers for operator correlation. Security/Privacy: request_id is opaque UUIDv4; no PII added to logs. Rollout plan: staged rollout by gateway pods behind feature flag for 48h, monitor errors/traces and metric cardinality. Revert plan included. Links: Linear ENG-4021 (observability), ENG-4120 (streaming stability).
